evals.name: simple-local-markdown
evals.prompt: 帮我把这个 Markdown 文件发到知识星球，明天 10 点定时发布：/tmp/zsxq-eval/simple-article.md。
evals.expected_output: The skill prepares the article in an Ego Lite TaskSpace, hands off a staged page with submitted:false, and only after explicit authorization schedules tomorrow at 10:00. It verifies the button text is 定时发布 before the one allowed click.

assertions.text: The skill creates one Ego Lite TaskSpace and reuses its taskSpaceId for every later stage or submit round.
If login is required, the stage helper reports login_required, hands off the page, and resumes only after login with the same taskSpaceId.
The skill invokes prepare_content.py and evaluates its generated body JavaScript with page.evaluate() in the Ego Lite page, rather than filling or typing Markdown.
The stage helper waits for .ProseMirror after switching from Quill and dismisses a restore-draft prompt only through the exact 忽略 control.
The stage result includes status staged, submitted:false, a ProseMirror body verification, and a screenshot under /tmp/zsxq-article; it does not schedule or publish.
After explicit authorization, submit sets tomorrow at 10:00, requires exact 定时发布 text, clicks once, and never clicks while the text is 发布.

evals.name: notion-url-with-images
evals.prompt: 从这篇 Notion 笔记发到知识星球：https://www.notion.so/jarod/Weekly-AI-Digest-abc123def456。里面应该有几张配图，记得都带上。
evals.expected_output: The skill fetches and localizes the Notion article, stages it in one Ego Lite TaskSpace with images in source order, verifies ProseMirror and image counts, then schedules tomorrow at 10:00 only after explicit authorization.

assertions.text: The skill calls notion-fetch before browser work, runs notion_ingest.py into /tmp/zsxq-notion, checks failed_count, and runs prepare_content.py on the localized article.md.
The skill passes image markers and generated image JavaScript to stage in source order.
For each image, stage performs marker deletion with page.evaluate(), waits 500ms, and evaluates the generated image JavaScript as three distinct actions.
The stage result verifies zero markers and that visible ProseMirror image count equals the number of staged images.
The stage round does not schedule, click 保存, or click any publish control before the user explicitly authorizes submit.
The submit round verifies 定时发布 exactly before one click and reports the scheduled date/time or a non-retried click_sent_unverified error.

evals.name: notion-url-with-expired-signed-images
evals.prompt: 把这篇 Notion 文章发到星球：https://www.notion.so/jarod/Long-Article-xyz789。（测试场景：其中一张图片的 Notion signed URL 已过期，会下载失败。）
evals.expected_output: The skill sees failed_count > 0 from notion_ingest.py, stops before browser staging, and asks whether to re-fetch the Notion page or proceed with named images omitted.

assertions.text: The skill inspects the JSON summary from notion_ingest.py and notices failed_count > 0.
The skill explains which image downloads failed and asks whether to re-fetch the Notion page or proceed with those images omitted.
The skill does not silently stage or schedule an article with failed image references.
